implemented.interface: Prominent Zen / Research switch. Zen shows solar activity and one human or market indicator, a time-period selector and optional Fibonacci overlay. Sources remain available in one disclosure.
implemented.preservation: Research keeps every existing layer, historical Timewave, transforms, sequence table and export. Views share selected dates and human measure while retaining separate layer visibility and Research transform settings.
implemented.fibonacci_overlay: Raw residues on a 0–8 scale, mapped to the solar chart height. The legend identifies the mapping. Shared clock and origin remain accessible in Research.

social_data_boundary.user_direction: Import existing analysed data from researchers, platforms or commercial providers. Do not build a social crawler, sentiment classifier, bullying detector or moderation pipeline.
social_data_boundary.kp: Retain Kp at its native three-hour resolution, with eight intervals per UTC day and a 24-hour inspection window. Hp60 is optional and not a prerequisite.
social_data_boundary.hypothesis: Investigate associations between geomagnetic activity indexed by Kp and aggregate online behaviour, including predefined delayed responses. Physiological and psychological mechanisms remain hypotheses requiring separate evidence.
social_data_boundary.status: No social provider or Kp feed has been integrated in this release.

provider_shortlist.name: Brandwatch
provider_shortlist.fit: Existing hourly sentiment and emotion charts with CSV export. Consumer Research also documents aggregate API retrieval. Closest documented route for a near-term emotional-tone comparison.
provider_shortlist.cadence: Hourly, daily, weekly and monthly in the documented Listen interface
provider_shortlist.access: Commercial. Confirm product, historical coverage, aggregate API entitlement and display rights before selecting a plan.
provider_shortlist.limit: Emotion classification in the documented Listen product is English-only. Sentiment and anger are distinct from hate speech or bullying. Coverage reflects the chosen query and supported sources.

provider_shortlist.name: HateLab / Nisien HERO
provider_shortlist.fit: Cardiff University research led by Professors Matt Williams and Pete Burnap, developed into Nisien's online safeguarding platform. Strongest thematic match for hate and abuse.
provider_shortlist.cadence: Provider advertises real-time monitoring; three-hour aggregate delivery is unconfirmed
provider_shortlist.access: Research partnership or commercial discussion. No public aggregate API or fixed price was verified.

provider_shortlist.name: Public Discourse Indicator
provider_shortlist.fit: Already classified toxicity and hate-speech proportions in Swiss news comments, including uncertainty ranges.
provider_shortlist.access: Public aggregate CSV download successfully retrieved; redistribution terms need confirmation before integration.
provider_shortlist.limit: German and French news-comment populations. Useful for longer comparisons; not a three-hour feed.

provider_shortlist.name: University of Vermont Hedonometer
provider_shortlist.fit: Already calculated daily happiness scores from online language; useful as a historical comparison.
provider_shortlist.access: Public API documented under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. API retrieval succeeded.
provider_shortlist.limit: The English Twitter query for dates from 1 January 2026 returned zero records. Do not present this source as a verified current feed or a bullying measure.

platform_partnerships.direction: Meta or X partnerships remain options for provider-supplied aggregate measures. Their standard public-content access tools alone do not meet the request for finished behavioural indices.

universal_one.status: Bottom-right planet design preview added in Zen and Research; no AI API or training connection.
universal_one.role: A guide in Zen and Research that helps ask questions, compare self-similarity within and between series, and distinguish visual structure, statistical evidence and interpretation.
universal_one.data_foundation: Retain source observations and versioned JSON/CSV with native units, sampling cadence, missingness, timezone and transformations. The current page exports JSON; a dedicated CSV view export is a future addition.
universal_one.analysis: Predefine relevant scales and lags, compare with baselines that preserve autocorrelation, account for searching many patterns, and test on held-out periods. Report effect sizes, uncertainty and sensitivity to normalization or phase choices.
universal_one.outcomes: A repeatable relationship, an inconclusive result and a chance-level match are all valid findings. Visual resemblance alone establishes neither causation nor meaning.

mini_tensor.status: Implemented kernel.json plus JSON Schema, content hash manifest and view export reference
mini_tensor.analysis: Protocol only; no correlation, coherence or chaos results asserted; no MCP server or agent execution added.

background.selected: Existing Inner Planes: ISS - The Blue Pearl
background.presentation: Silent loop with black overlay, pause control and reduced-motion support
background.ultimate_direction: Measured weather, thermal or hyperspectral visualisations. Simulated filters, if added later, require an artistic-visualisation label.

candidates.title: NASA Earth System Science Spheres
candidates.note: Rotating globes with PACE, SWOT and GRACE-FO data; PACE biosphere maps chlorophyll and plant pigments, distinct from temperature.

candidates.title: NASA Sea Surface Temperature — Near Real Time
candidates.note: MUR sea surface temperature analysis visualisation; thermal mapping, distinct from hyperspectral imaging.

candidates.title: NOAA GOES weather imagery
candidates.note: Multispectral GeoColor; daytime visible and nighttime infrared with static night-light reference.
